text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got a show at the school coming up
with the
best crew in the biz! ★ You
better be there to
turn it up, bestieee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You bet! Which songs are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Good question! I was thinking something
like the
songs you showed me... the ones
that slap and go
super hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay! I'll list up some of my other
favs.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Can't forget the glitter tape!
Everything's
gotta pop, right? But...
cleanup might be a pain,
huh? Uuugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be a tape that doesn't
drop glitter
everywhere. Just leave it to
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tell me anything you wanna do.
Whatever it is, I
bet we can make it
work!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! You're legit the MVP of this party! For real, I'm so hyped for this party! WOOT!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I'm the one who's hyped now just
talking to
you! You gotta hit everyone
with that killer smile!
